steps.label: prep
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/ink/"* . && rm -rf s && bash prep.sh | head -c 300

steps.label: stills
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ink_main" && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b ink.blend -P ink_render.py -- stills 50 31,551,601,623,763,1263,1339,1406 > st.log 2>&1; grep -a FRAME st.log | tr '\n' ' '; a=""; for f in s/f*.jpg; do a="$a $f ink/e2/$(basename $f)"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2
